C0031.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of title 42, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State shall: (1) inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected; (2) require the entity to correct the deficiency; (3)(A) offer training and technical assistance, if appropriate, to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered, or (B) if the State determines that such training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for the determination; (4)(A) at the discretion of the State (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct the deficiency), allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct such deficiency within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the State, and (B) not later than 30 days after receiving from an eligible entity a proposed quality improvement plan pursuant to subparagraph (A), either approve such proposed plan or specify the reasons why the proposed plan cannot be approved; and (5) after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under this chapter of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
C0031.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0032.summary: A determination by a State to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary.

C0033.summary: The Secretary shall, upon request, review a determination by a State to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity.

C0034.summary: The review by the Secretary of a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding shall be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.

C0035.summary: If the Secretary's review of a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding is not completed within 90 days, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.
C0035.scope_text: If the review is not completed within 90 days

C0036.summary: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of title 42 and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b) of 42 U.S.C. 9915, the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under this chapter to the eligible entity affected until the violation is corrected.
C0036.scope_text: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b)

C0037.summary: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of title 42 and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing and the Secretary's review, and the Secretary provides financial assistance to the affected entity under 42 U.S.C. 9915(c), the grant or allotment for the State under section 9905 or 9906 of title 42 for the earliest appropriate fiscal year shall be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under subsection (c) to such eligible entity.

inventory.U0000: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review under section 9914, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement or the State plan to provide services under this chapter, or fails to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected.
inventory.U0001: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review under section 9914, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement or the State plan to provide services under this chapter, or fails to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must require the entity to correct the deficiency.
inventory.U0002: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, as one alternative, offer training and technical assistance if appropriate to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered.
inventory.U0003: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, as an alternative if it determines that training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for that determination.
inventory.U0004: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State is authorized, at its discretion (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct it), to allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct the deficiency within a reasonable period of time as determined by the State.
inventory.U0005: Not later than 30 days after receiving a proposed quality improvement plan from an eligible entity pursuant to subparagraph (A), the State must either approve the proposed plan or specify the reasons why it cannot be approved.
inventory.U0006: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under this chapter of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
inventory.U0007: A State determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary, and the Secretary must review such a determination upon request.
inventory.U0008: The Secretary's review of a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding must be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.
inventory.U0009: If the Secretary's review is not completed within 90 days after receiving all necessary documentation from the State, the determination of the State becomes final at the end of the 90th day.
inventory.U0010: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b), the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under this chapter to the affected eligible entity until the violation is corrected.
inventory.U0011: Whenever the Secretary provides direct assistance under subsection (c) because a State prematurely terminated or reduced funding in violation of section 9908(b)(8) assurances, the State's grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 for the earliest appropriate fiscal year must be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under subsection (c) to the eligible entity.

claim_judgments.rationale: C0031 accurately combines and faithfully expresses the complete multi-part mandate imposed on a State under subsection (a) when an eligible entity fails to comply with agreement terms or standards, covering paragraphs (1) through (5) including reporting, discretionary quality improvement plan timelines, and hearing requirements prior to termination or reduction.
C0032 faithfully represents the first sentence of subsection (b), establishing that a State determination to terminate designation or reduce funding is reviewable by the Secretary.
C0033 accurately states the Secretary's obligation under subsection (b) to review such a determination upon request.
C0034 correctly states the requirement that the Secretary complete the review within 90 days after receiving all necessary documentation from the State.
C0035 faithfully records the statutory rule that if review is not completed within 90 days, the State's determination becomes final at the end of the 90th day.

C0036 accurately captures the Secretary's discretionary authority under subsection (c) to provide direct financial assistance to an affected eligible entity if a State violates section 9908(b)(8) assurances by prematurely terminating or reducing funding.

C0037 faithfully conveys the second sentence of subsection (c), requiring the reduction of the State's grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 by an amount equal to direct assistance funds provided.

unit_judgments.rationale: The requirement to inform the entity of the deficiency is fully captured within the comprehensive scope and text of C0031.
The requirement to require the entity to correct the deficiency is fully covered by item (2) in C0031.
The requirement to offer training and technical assistance if appropriate and report to the Secretary is fully covered by item (3)(A) in C0031.
The alternative requirement to submit a report stating reasons when training and technical assistance are determined not appropriate is fully covered by item (3)(B) in C0031.
The State's discretionary option to allow development and implementation of a quality improvement plan within 60 days is preserved in item (4)(A) of C0031.
The requirement to approve or specify reasons within 30 days after receiving a proposed plan is retained in item (4)(B) of C0031.
The requirement to initiate proceedings to terminate designation or reduce funding after notice and hearing unless corrected is retained in item (5) of C0031.
Jointly covered by C0032 (reviewability of State determination) and C0033 (duty of the Secretary to review upon request).
The 90-day deadline for completing the Secretary's review following receipt of all documentation is fully covered by C0034.
The finality of the State's determination at the end of the 90th day if review is not completed is fully captured in C0035.
The Secretary's authority to provide direct financial assistance until the violation is corrected is fully captured in C0036.
The mandatory offset reduction against the State's grant or allotment for the earliest appropriate fiscal year is fully captured in C0037.
